name: Industrial Heavy Duty Flexible PVC Traffic Cones (750mm / 30-Inch)
shortDescription: High-durability 750mm bright fluorescent orange PVC traffic pylon with heavy weighted black rubber base and high-intensity prismatic reflective sleeve.
overview: Engineered for maximum highway, urban, and industrial traffic delineation, these 750mm (30-inch) heavy-duty traffic cones provide immediate daytime and night-time hazard warning. Injection-molded from 100% premium virgin flexible polyvinyl chloride (PVC), the cone body bounces back to shape without fracturing even when run over by heavy utility vehicles. The wide, vulcanized high-density black rubber base lowers the cone's center of gravity, guaranteeing that it stays upright during violent air displacement from passing trucks and highway winds.
keyFeatures: Injection molded virgin PVC body retains flexibility from -20°C to +65°C
Crush-resistant memory elastomer springs back to shape after vehicular roll-over
High-density recycled vulcanized rubber base prevents tipping in high winds
Brilliant fluorescent orange color treated with UV inhibitors to prevent sun bleaching
Fitted with high-intensity prismatic (HIP) micro-prismatic retro-reflective collar
Recessed top ring and stackable base design for compact storage and rapid deployment
Conforms to IRC (Indian Roads Congress) and MUTCD highway traffic standards
applications: Highway maintenance, road repaving, and detour lane guidance
Industrial loading bays, warehouse forklift lanes, and crane pads
Commercial parking lots, valet zones, and emergency roadblocks
Airport apron vehicle management and sporting event crowd control
